import sqlite3,json
c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');c.execute('create virtual table f using fts5(text,candidate_id UNINDEXED)');c.executemany('insert into f(rowid,text,candidate_id) values(?,?,?)',[(1,'alpha phrase','A'),(2,'beta phrase','B')]);c.execute("update f_content set c1=case id when 1 then 'B' else 'A' end");print(json.dumps({'integrity':c.execute('pragma integrity_check(f)').fetchall(),'alpha_result':c.execute('select candidate_id,text from f where f match ? order by bm25(f)',('"alpha phrase"',)).fetchall(),'candidate_id_set':c.execute('select candidate_id from f order by candidate_id').fetchall()}));c.close()
